text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's time for summer training camp once 
again! Let's build up our strength 
properly for the autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination, I step off the 
bus, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Are the people over there 
reporters?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Zenno Rob Roy is gazing, 
there is indeed a crew that seems to have 
come for some kind of interview, checking 
their equipment.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you for your hard work! Thank 
you for always taking care of us! I'm so 
sorry for making such a fuss...!
choice_data_list:
No. Is this for a special interview or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We're planning to produce a special 
feature following the Junior-class 
Umamusume participating in summer camp, so 
we're gathering material—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, we have received permission from the 
Academy! We will make sure not to be a 
nuisance, so please bear with us...!"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! They say that 'certain girl' is 
arriving on the next bus! We should get a 
shot of her getting off, right?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really?! I'll be right there! 
...E-Excuse me, I must take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… Having media coverage at a summer 
training camp isn't that unusual in 
itself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Focusing mainly on Junior Class girls, and 
doing an intimate close-up coverage at 
that... I haven't really heard of that 
before...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Could it have something to do with that 
'particular girl'...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the ones who draw the most 
attention in the Twinkle Series are the 
Umamusume competing on the frontlines of 
the Classic and Senior years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this stage, what Junior Class 
Umamusume show is merely a glimpse of 
their potential. But—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Could the reason she's drawing this much 
attention be... because her raw talent is 
just on a completely different level?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...It might be best to look into this 
properly.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...I'm, surprised.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
('Monthly Twinkle,' 'Nessho Shinbun,' 
'Winners.net,' 'U-RACE LIFE'... ...and so 
many others.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Virtually every single media outlet is 
running a special feature on "her"...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...The reporter I met this morning 
mentioned they were 'doing a close-up on 
Junior Class Umamusume,' but—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather... could this be an exclusive 
feature specifically arranged to cover her 
close-up...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘We bore witness.’ ‘A stride beyond the 
ordinary.’ ‘Overwhelming power radiating 
from that small frame.’ ‘Even her training 
scenes draw you in.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now is merely the calm before the 
storm." "—If she were to make her debut, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She could undeniably become a figure that 
leads an era." "No, far more than that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Her name shall surely be etched with 
great impact into history, into the world, 
strongly and for eternity.’"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The time will surely come when everyone 
calls her that."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...... "With the Hero..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...A hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A hero, huh...?
